evidence.exact_span: The confusing nature of that document came to light after the hearing had begun. The applicants then sought leave, which I granted, to file a notice of motion seeking leave to file a further amended application in the form of the 'proposed further amended application as at 03.10.07' in which the paragraph numbering had been corrected. Such a notice of motion was filed in Court on 4 October 2007 in proceeding NSD 371/2007 only.
